sample.note: 2/10 trials show regret (insurance_pricing_f and educational_intervention_g), but only 1 has complete gap ratings. N=1 regret-positive case with gap rating. All intervals are extremely wide. Sensitivity = 100% at all thresholds, but PPV = 0.2 at threshold >=2, 0.5 at threshold >=3.

headline.claim: A blinded epistemic-gap rating showed 100% sensitivity but PPV=0.2 at threshold >=2. Regret rate was 20% (2/10), but only one regret case had a gap rating. The single regret-positive case with gap rating cannot establish predictive validity.

contrasting_cases.note: N=1 regret-positive case with gap rating. Highest regret (980875) with gap >=2. TRUE POSITIVE: gap detected regret case.
Gap=1 (<2 threshold), regret=0. TRUE NEGATIVE: no gap, no regret.

critical_limitation: 2 trials have regret, but only 1 has a complete gap rating. N=1 regret-positive case with gap rating limits statistical power. Sensitivity=100% (TP=1, FP=4) but PPV=0.2 overall, 0.5 at threshold >=3. Cannot establish predictive validity.
